title: Swiss catalog model metadata
description: models/<name>/metadata.yaml: the cosmetic half of a model, shared by every version. Nothing here decides what a deploy renders, which is why it may be edited in place -- a description fixed today must not require republishing a version somebody has pinned. Anything that changes what gets deployed (servedName, source, variants) lives in the version file and is immutable.

name.description: Catalog id. Unique across the catalog, and the default served-model name.

family.description: Grouping key for the UI (glm, qwen, kimi, ...). Cosmetic.

deprecated.description: Hidden from the marketplace by default; existing deploys still resolve. A string is shown as the reason.

tuning.description: Measured tuning results: a tuned variant against a baseline, both in one published version, on the tuning benchmark. Display only -- nothing composes from it -- so a re-measurement is an edit here, not a new version. hack/validate-schema.js checks that the version is published and that both ids are variants of it. The report is optional until CI generates it.

version.description: The published version both variants belong to.

baseline.description: Id of the variant measured as the baseline.

uplift.description: The headline result: percent gained over the baseline on the tuning benchmark, 44 meaning +44%. When the benchmark ran several workloads, the one to lead with; all of them go in `workloads`.

workloads.description: Per-workload results, when the benchmark ran more than one.

name.description: The workload, as the report names it, such as "50k + 1.5k" (input + output tokens).

uplift.description: Percent gained over the baseline on this workload.

report.description: Optional HTML report filename beside this metadata.yaml. TODO: generate and link this report from CI.

source.description: Model identity, never a location. The chart mounts weights from model.localPath on the host, which is a fact about a cluster -- the site profile derives that path from `hf`, and preflight checks it exists. Shared by every version: a different repo id is a different model, not a new version of this one.

revision.description: Commit sha or tag. Pin it when the repo's main branch moves.

sizeGiB.description: On-disk size of the weights. Feeds the site's disk preflight; not a chart value.
